settings: a plugin's settings, secrets and capability grants: /v1/settings/plugins?target=<id> (contracts/settings-v1 1.1, the plugins scope)

checks.manifest_missing: no plugin.json at the plugin's root
checks.unknown_field: a field plugin-v1 does not have (refused, not ignored)
checks.bad_value: a field's value breaks the manifest schema
checks.kind_rules: a field the kind does not take
checks.duplicate_name: two contributions (or secrets) of one name
checks.annotation_missing: an MCP tool lacks one of readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint, openWorldHint
checks.extra_properties: an MCP tool's input schema, or an object in it, does not say additionalProperties false
checks.tool_schema: an MCP tool's input schema is not of type object
checks.stage_unknown: a hook names a stage hooks-v1 does not have
checks.role_not_allowed: a hook's role cannot run at that stage
checks.capability_missing: a hook's payload or a decision provider is not covered by a requested prompts: capability
checks.path_outside: a path leaves the plugin's folder
checks.path_missing: a path the manifest names is not in the plugin
checks.settings_schema: the settings schema is not one a form can draw (proxy/schemaform.py STRICT)
checks.signature_invalid: plugin.sig.json is present and does not hold for this tree
checks.incompatible_tandemapp: tandemapp does not hold for this TandemApp
checks.incompatible_hooks_api: hooks_api is newer than (or of another major than) this controller's
checks.incompatible_plugin_api: plugin_api is newer than (or of another major than) this controller's
checks.special_file: a device, fifo or socket in the tree
checks.bad_name: a name with a control character
